core_obligations: Set up the reduction (proof lines 5388-5396): take the closed immersion and the blowing up provided by the reduction lemma, together with the cycle whose pullback pushes forward to the class of the closed subscheme, and use the compatibility for projective space bundles to translate the pushforward of its cycle class into the unit.

Compute the pushforward (proof lines 5396-5415): applying pushforwards along the closed immersion and along the blowing up rewrites the class of the unit as the pushforward of the product of the class of the divisor with the cycle class of the chosen cycle; by additivity of the cycle class map and the multiplicativity of intersection this becomes the pushforward of the pullback of the class of the closed subscheme, which by the projection formula is the product of the pushforward of the unit with the class of the closed subscheme.

Conclude (proof lines 5415-5419): the pushforward of the unit along the blowing up is one, so the expression becomes the cycle class of the closed subscheme, which is the required compatibility of the cycle class map with the pushforward along the closed immersion.
proof_roadmap: Use the reduction lemma and the compatibility for projective space bundles.
Rewrite the class of the unit through the divisor class and the projection formula.
Use that the pushforward of the unit along the blowing up is one to conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying the first eight axioms the cycle class map commutes with pushforward (statement lines 5384-5386). The proof (proof lines 5387-5419) uses the reduction to a vanishing cycle on a blowing up of a closed subscheme, the compatibility for projective space bundles, axiom (A9) for divisors, the projection formula, and the computation of the pushforward of the unit along the blowing up. H3: a multi step computation, written out in full.
